**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Urging or requesting (someone) solemnly or earnestly to do something
solution: The correct answer is **"Adjure."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Adjure"** means to urge or request someone solemnly or earnestly to do something. (किसी को कुछ करने के लिए गंभीरतापूर्वक या ईमानदारी से आग्रह या अनुरोध करना) • **Example**: *The lawyer **adjured**__ the witness to speak the truth.* • It is a verb and is pronounced as ad-joo r. • So, urging or requesting (someone) solemnly or earnestly to do something means **"Adjure."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Arena**: a place where sports, concerts, or other events take place. (रंगस्‍थली, क्रीड़ांगन) • **Arrears**: money that is owed and should have been paid earlier. (बक़ाया राशि • **Armada**: a fleet of warships. (युद्धपोतों का एक बेड़ा) 36:Tce5, The correct answer is **"grate."**
